params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Garen}} continually {{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}} a portion of his {{sti|health|{{as|'''maximum''' health}}}}.
params.blurb2: This ability is temporarily disabled if he is attacked by epic {{tip|monsters}}, enemy {{tip|turrets}}, or enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Garen''' {{sti|health regeneration|link=true|regenerates}} an additional{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|1.5+0.2*(x-1) for 6;then + 0.8*x for 7; then + 0.4*x|formula=1.3%+0.2% per level up to level 6, then+0.8% up to level 13, then+0.4%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every 5 seconds.|{{as|{{pplevel|key=%|(1.5+0.2*(x-1))/10 for 6;then + 0.8/10*x for 7; then + 0.4/10*x|formula=0.13%+0.02% per level up to level 6, then+0.08% up to level 13, then+0.04%}} of his {{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds.}}
params.description2: ''Perseverance'' is lost for {{tt|8 seconds|Not a cooldown, unaffected by ability haste}} if '''Garen''' takes damage from {{tip|champion|champions}}, epic {{tip|monster|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or if he is hit by an enemy {{tip|ability}} or affected by an enemy [[summoner spell]], refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.
params.notes:
* ''Perseverance'' does not go on nor refresh its cooldown from damage which was:
** Reduced to or equal to [[Damage#0_Damage_Instances|0 damage]].
** Dealt to {{tip|shield|shields}}.
** Absorbed by {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Garen continually regenerates a portion of his maximum health.

blurb2.plain: This ability is temporarily disabled if he is attacked by epic monsters, enemy turrets, or enemy champions.

description.plain: Innate: Garen regenerates an additional⟦pplevel⟧ of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

description2.plain: Perseverance is lost for 8 seconds if Garen takes damage from champions, epic monsters, or turrets, or if he is hit by an enemy ability or affected by an enemy summoner spell, refreshing on subsequent damage and hits taken from them.

params.blurb2: His next {{tip|basic attack}} will {{tip|lunge}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, {{tip|silence|silencing}} the target.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself of all {{tip|slow|slows}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|35% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a duration.
params.description2: Additionally, '''Garen''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within {{fd|4.5}} seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, {{tip|lunge}} at the target, deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, and {{tip|silence}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
params.description3: ''Decisive Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Garen's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* The enhanced attack will apply other {{tip|on-hit}} effects and can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} as normal (the bonus damage does not).
** The bonus damage will also apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
** The bonus damage is applied to {{tip|structures}}.
* When {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}}, the {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} of ''Decisive Strike'' will be increased by ~6.5%.{{bug}}<!--first noticed early in season 16 but I forgot to add it, possibly a result of crit changes somehow-->
* ''Decisive Strike'' locks '''Garen''' out of using basic attacks for a short period of time.<!--The enhanced attack or the ability itself?--> This is shortened with {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.
* The enhanced attack will still complete and hit the target even if they become {{tip|untargetable}} during the {{tip|attack windup|attack's windup}}.
* ''Decisive Strike'' will not prevent the reapplication of {{tip|slow|slows}} (e.g. the persistent slow from {{ai|Pillar of Ice|Trundle}} will be immediately reapplied after removal if '''Garen''' is still within its [[area of effect]]).
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only negate the {{tip|silence}}.
* ''Decisive Strike's'' {{tip|lunge}} can pass very thin terrain and will otherwise not be able to. In any case, '''Garen''' will still hit his target.[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qi54mu_gxg]

blurb.plain: Active: Garen gains bonus movement speed and cleanses from slows.

blurb2.plain: His next basic attack will lunge and deal bonus physical damage, silencing the target.

description.plain: Active: Garen cleanses himself of all slows and gains 35% bonus movement speed for a duration.

description2.plain: Additionally, Garen empowers his next basic attack within 4.5 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, lunge at the target, deal bonus physical damage, and silence them for 1.5 seconds.

description3.plain: Decisive Strike resets Garen's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Garen}} permanently gains '''bonus''' {{as|{{sti|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic resistance|{{as|magic resist}}}} by killing enemies, up to a cap. Upon reaching the cap, he gains another permanent boost to these defenses.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for a few seconds. He also briefly gains a {{tip|shield}} and increased {{tip|tenacity}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Garen''' kills an enemy, he generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Courage'', stacking up to 150 times.
params.description2: {{sbc|Courage:}} For each stack, '''Garen''' gains {{sti|armor|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|{{fd|0.2}} '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, up to a maximum of 30 '''bonus''' resistances each.
params.description3: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' reduces incoming damage for 4 seconds. For the first {{fd|0.75}} seconds, '''Garen''' additionally grants himself a {{tip|shield}} and 60% {{tip|tenacity}}.
params.notes:
* ''Courage's'' '''bonus''' resistances can be obtained by any of '''Garen's''' damage sources (basic attacks, abilities, summoner spells, runes, item actives).
** This does not include ''last hits'' transferred to '''Garen''' artificially.
* The kills on these enemy unit types count towards ''Courage'' stacks:
** {{tip|champion|Champions}} (Only [[kill]]s, [[assist]]s don't grant stacks)
** All {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monster|monsters}}
** [[Champion summoned units]] (e.g. {{ai|Noxious Trap|Teemo}}, {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank}})
** All {{tip|pet|pets}} and {{tip|clone|clones}}.
*** The bonus is equal for all these units; ''large'' units do not grant a larger bonus.
* The kills on these enemy unit types do '''not''' count towards ''Courage'' stacks:
** {{tip|Wards}}.
** {{tip|Turrets}} (including {{ai|Shurima's Legacy|Azir|Sun Disk}}) and other {{tip|structures}}
** [[Jungle plants]].
** Units destroyed by 'trampling' such as {{cai|Rampant Growth|Zyra|seeds}}, {{cai|Cell Division|Zac|goo}} or {{cai|Tunnel|Rek'Sai|tunnels}}.
** {{cai|I|Illaoi|Tentacles}} and {{cai|Dark Procession|Yorick}}
* ''Courage'' will only grant bonus resistances from units killed by '''Garen''' himself. {{ii|Eye of the Herald}} does not count.
* The {{tip|Tenacity}} increase {{tip|stacks additively}} with the ''tenacity reduction'' from {{tip|Brittle}}, but multiplicatively with other sources.

blurb.plain: Passive: Garen permanently gains bonus armor and magic resist by killing enemies, up to a cap. Upon reaching the cap, he gains another permanent boost to these defenses.

blurb2.plain: Active: Garen reduces incoming damage for a few seconds. He also briefly gains a shield and increased tenacity.

description.plain: Passive: Whenever Garen kills an enemy, he generates a stack of Courage, stacking up to 150 times.

description2.plain: Courage: For each stack, Garen gains 0.2 bonus armor and 0.2 bonus magic resistance, up to a maximum of 30 bonus resistances each.

description3.plain: Active: Garen reduces incoming damage for 4 seconds. For the first 0.75 seconds, Garen additionally grants himself a shield and 60% tenacity.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Garen}} rapidly spins with his sword for a short time while {{tip|ghosted}}, continually dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies. He spins more based on his {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
params.blurb2: The nearest enemy is dealt increased damage. Enemy {{tip|champions}} hit by enough spins will have {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|reduced armor}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Garen''' rapidly spins his sword around himself 7 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|25% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Only bonus attack speed from item stats and growth (per level)}}) times over 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to declare basic attacks but gaining {{tip|ghosting}} and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies {{tt|periodically|Spin rate is 3 ÷ number of spins}}. ''Judgment'' can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.
params.leveling: {{st|Physical Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4 to 16}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 52}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+0.3) to 16*(1+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+0.3) to 52*(1+0.3)}}% AD)}}|{{ii|Infinity Edge|IE}} Damage Per Spin|{{ap|4*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 16*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3) to 52*(1+{{#var:ie_mod}}+0.3)}}% AD)}}}}
params.description2: Enemy champions hit 6 times by ''Judgment'' are inflicted with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 6 seconds, with the duration refreshing upon the 7th hit and every 6th hit thereafter.
params.description3: ''Judgment'' deals {{ap|(1.25-1)*100}}% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.
params.description5: ''Judgment'' can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|130|30}}|critical damage}} damage.|{{sti|{{as|30% '''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}
params.notes:
* At level 20, '''Garen''' will spin a minimum of {{ap|7+{{#expr:floor(({{ccd|Garen|as_lvl}}*(20-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(20-1)))/25)}}}} times.
* Deactivating the ability manually does not count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* Each spin triggers a stack of {{ri|Conqueror}}.
* For the purpose of moving closer to an enemy when right clicking them, ''Judgment'' also reduces '''Garen's''' {{sti|attack range|link=range}} {{ft|to 100|by 75}} for the duration.
* ''Judgment'' only scales with {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} from items and growth (per level).
* ''Judgment'' cancels '''Garen's''' last movement command upon ending.
* Each spin deals damage simultaneously to all enemies within its range when the spin is completed.
* The spin animation is capped at {{as|{{tt|200%|Once per 0.2 seconds, 15 spins total}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}, but the amount of ticks will keep on scaling.
* The armor reduction stacks multiplicatively with other percentage armor penetration effects.

blurb2.plain: The nearest enemy is dealt increased damage. Enemy champions hit by enough spins will have reduced armor.

Judgment can be recast after 1 second while active, and does so automatically after it ends.

description3.plain: Judgment deals 25% increased damage against the nearest enemy hit.
